queries.countRealSessionCostUndeterminedSince: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" o   WHERE o.side = 'SELL' AND o.session_id IS NOT NULL AND o.session_kind = :kind   AND o.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND o.sell_applied_at >= :since AND o.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT bo.position_id, SUM(bo.applied_executed_funds + bo.applied_paid_fee) AS cost, SUM(bo.filled_quantity) AS qty FROM "order" bo WHERE bo.side = 'BUY' AND bo.position_id IS NOT NULL AND bo.filled_quantity > 0 GROUP BY bo.position_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(bo.applied_executed_funds) AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(bo.applied_paid_fee)) b WHERE b.position_id = o.position_id)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM position p   WHERE p.session_kind = :kind AND p.session_id IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'CLOSED'   AND p.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND p.closed_at >= :since   AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bq.filled_quantity), 0) FROM "order" bq        WHERE bq.position_id = p.id AND bq.side = 'BUY' AND bq.filled_quantity > 0)     > (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sq.filled_quantity), 0) FROM "order" sq        WHERE sq.position_id = p.id AND sq.side = 'SELL' AND sq.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL        AND sq.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL))
queries.sumLiveSessionRealizedLossSince: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl), 0) FROM ( SELECT o.applied_executed_funds - COALESCE(o.applied_paid_fee, 0) - (o.filled_quantity * b.cost) / b.qty AS pnl FROM "order" o JOIN (SELECT bo.position_id, SUM(bo.applied_executed_funds + bo.applied_paid_fee) AS cost, SUM(bo.filled_quantity) AS qty FROM "order" bo WHERE bo.side = 'BUY' AND bo.position_id IS NOT NULL AND bo.filled_quantity > 0 GROUP BY bo.position_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(bo.applied_executed_funds) AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(bo.applied_paid_fee)) b ON b.position_id = o.position_id WHERE o.side = 'SELL' AND o.session_id IS NOT NULL AND o.session_kind = 'LIVE' AND o.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND o.sell_applied_at >= :since AND o.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL) t WHERE pnl < 0
queries.costBasisPartsByPosition: SELECT p.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" b WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" b WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0    AND (b.applied_executed_funds IS NULL OR b.applied_paid_fee IS NULL)), (SELECT SUM(b.applied_executed_funds + b.applied_paid_fee) FROM "order" b    WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0), (SELECT SUM(b.filled_quantity) FROM "order" b WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" s WHERE s.position_id = p.id AND s.side = 'SELL' AND s.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL    AND s.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL), (SELECT SUM(s.applied_executed_funds - COALESCE(s.applied_paid_fee, 0)) FROM "order" s    WHERE s.position_id = p.id AND s.side = 'SELL' AND s.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND s.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL), (SELECT SUM(s.filled_quantity) FROM "order" s    WHERE s.position_id = p.id AND s.side = 'SELL' AND s.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND s.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL) FROM position p WHERE p.id IN (:ids)
